comparison.objective: Use a hand-held dustpan and brush to sweep five cubes; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tool holding and sweeping versus bimanual counterholding, recessed hex-key use, fine collar rotation, and bounded locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: All cubes swept into the dustpan without gripper contact versus two acceptable dynamic stops with retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both use two arms, but the task-specific contact mechanics and evaluated outcome differ substantially.
